paths.update.md: #2994 (epic #1671 Phase 6.3, FINAL slice): fragmentizes update.md onto the marker grammar, admitting `state:next-channel` (channel-banner section) and a new dedicated `init.update` entry point (cmdInitUpdate). update.md previously carried NO `gsd_run query init.*` call at all; the new INIT_UPDATE fetch (reusing the already-resolved $GSD_TOOLS from get_installed_version, dual .cjs/PATH-shim invocation style, matching the pre-existing update-context call) plus its surrounding comment outweighs the single `<!-- gsd:section -->` marker-pair stub that replaces the extracted channel-banner prose (now living in gsd-core/workflows/update/steps/channel-banner.md). Net SOURCE growth is +703 bytes (26,024 -> 26,727). The pre-existing TAG="next"/TAG="latest" case-statement in parse_update_channel is deliberately left byte-identical — issue #815's regression test (tests/issue-815-update-next-channel.test.cjs) asserts that literal text stays in the workflow, since the npm dist-tag selection must run in the workflow's own shell before any gsd_run round-trip. The EMITTED artifact composeWorkflow produces at install time still includes the extracted prose verbatim (markers strip, gap+section bodies re-join byte-for-byte) when the atom is unresolved (section_manifest null -> read-everything fallback), so installed behavior is unchanged; only the SOURCE file's on-disk byte count moves.
paths.new-milestone.md: #2994 (epic #1671 Phase 6.3, FINAL slice): fragmentizes new-milestone.md's Step 4 'Part A' milestone-state write onto the marker grammar, admitting `state:flat-mode` (project-md-milestone-write section) — the positively-phrased inverse of the new `state:workstream-active` atom (transition.md), introduced because the when= grammar has no negation operator and Part A's true condition ('skip when a workstream IS active') cannot negate `state:workstream-active` in its own marker. cmdInitNewMilestone now computes both workstreamActive and flatMode. Because Step 4 (where the marker lives) runs well before new-milestone.md's pre-existing init.new-milestone call (kept at Step 7, AFTER Step 6's phase archival so its phase_dir_count/roadmap_exists fields reflect POST-archival state, unmoved), a SECOND, section-manifest-only init.new-milestone call (INIT_EARLY) is added in Step 1 — init.new-milestone is a pure read with no mutation, so calling it twice is side-effect-free. Net SOURCE growth is +406 bytes (38,666 -> 39,072): the early INIT_EARLY fetch plus its explanatory comment, and the single gsd:section marker-pair stub, together outweigh the Part A prose the stub replaces (now living in gsd-core/workflows/new-milestone/steps/project-md-milestone-write.md). The EMITTED artifact composeWorkflow produces at install time still includes the extracted prose verbatim (markers strip, gap+section bodies re-join byte-for-byte) when the atom is unresolved (section_manifest null -> read-everything fallback), so installed behavior is unchanged; only the SOURCE file's on-disk byte count moves.
